answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond on the mesa registry for one orchard plot under one harvest key; the registry publishes plot, key, and yield. Each epoch the holder files one receipt. A hollow plot, with no delivery or a copied receipt, burns the bond and bars the key. A fake costs the 80 bond plus a fee from 50, rising 5 per plot held by the operator, so the kth fake costs 130 plus 5(k-1) and the 1000th costs 5125; 1000 fakes cost 2627500 total. A rented-plot ring fails because a receipt under another key mismatches the registered key. An honest grower pays one bond plus one 50 fee.
